item.title: Advancing Research on Health and Well-being in Entrepreneurship through Intervention Research: Bridging Relevance and Impact
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research focused on health and well-being outcomes for entrepreneurs, emphasizing intervention-based studies that bridge academic research with practical impact. The call seeks to advance understanding of how entrepreneurs' physical and mental health can be improved through targeted interventions and evidence-based approaches that have meaningful real-world applications.

Appel publié par Journal of Business Venturing Insights. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
